biological_interpretation: A subset of SETD1A/FIP200 transcriptional output falls near a TSC/mTOR/FIP200 neighborhood rather than being isolated chromatin or autophagy noise. / SETD1A loss has a selective mature-neuron organelle/mitochondrial RNA liability that is spatially gated rather than pan-glutamatergic.
caveats: The result is restricted-signature-based and transcriptomic; no phospho-mTORC1 substrate was measured.

The Tsc signatures were far larger than the Rb1cc1 signatures, and the correlation was calculated on the top 200 Rb1cc1-ranked genes; several top neighbors lack a direct FIP200 prior and remain exploratory.
Direct Setd1a transcript reduction was FDR-significant only in 155 MB Glut; 217 P MY Pineal Glut is low-count.

Exact log2 fold changes, scores, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet; the graph and cluster summaries were used only to nominate the target/readout combinations.
exact_observed_result: Setd1a loss showed a modest mTORC1-neighbor signature in 155 MB Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA, with repeated Nprl3 down-regulation and positive restricted-signature similarity to Tsc1/Tsc2; Rb1cc1 signatures in 155 MB Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA also aligned positively with larger Tsc1/Tsc2 signatures. / Setd1a perturbation caused a cell-class-skewed, mostly down-regulated program maximal in 155 MB Glut and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, with recurrent repression of organelle and mitochondrial genes, while many telencephalic glutamatergic classes lacked FDR downstream genes. Parquet-verified leading rows: Setd1a->Itfg1 in 155 MB Glut log2FC -1.41, FDR 3.91e-23; Setd1a->Fbxw5 in 155 MB Glut log2FC -1.6, FDR 3.91e-23; Setd1a->Itfg1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.99, FDR 6.38e-15; Setd1a->Foxred1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -1.04, FDR 1.93e-14; Setd1a->Dzip3 in 155 MB Glut log2FC -0.913, FDR 2.90e-14; Setd1a->Nprl3 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -1.55, FDR 3.00e-13.

finding_summaries.direction: Setd1a signature positively correlated with Tsc1/Tsc2 perturbations; Nprl3 down
finding_summaries.summary: Setd1a loss showed a modest mTORC1-neighbor signature: Nprl3 was repeatedly down, and Tsc1/Tsc2 perturbations were positive restricted-signature neighbors in MB Glut, TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, and MB P MY GABA.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: NPRL3 and TSC1:TSC2 inhibit mTORC1 through different upstream branches, so the pattern nominates mTORC1 activation as a mechanistic hypothesis that can be assayed orthogonally.

finding_summaries.summary: Tsc1 and Tsc2 perturbations, although much stronger globally, aligned with the Rb1cc1 restricted signatures in 155 MB Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: This recovers a TSC/mTOR/FIP200 axis in the same cell classes where Rb1cc1 changes ER and neuronal membrane transcripts, supporting a pathway-neighbor relationship rather than an isolated off-pathway signature.

finding_summaries.summary: Setd1a perturbation gave a sharply cell-class-skewed, mostly down-regulated transcriptome that was maximal in 155 MB Glut and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut rather than uniform across brain classes.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: SETD1A is a broadly expressed chromatin enzyme, so the dataset identifies cellular contexts in which partial loss is transcriptionally exposed versus buffered.
